column1: # Targeted invariant-to-test traceability audit, 2026-09-07.
# Initial audit baseline: codex/invariant-fidelity-reopen-20260904 at 6bf45a55ad702ace661126f55e48a336d417307f.
# Planning only: charter, README ownership/method claims, generic registries, harness mounts,
# and selected generic test/roster functions. No holdout branches, diffs, or repro bodies used.
# Missing means an absent or insufficient claim-to-generator/oracle link in the index;
# it does not establish a production defect or the absence of evidence elsewhere.
# Source-composition checks remain useful drift guards, but need separately named executing
# generators, outcome oracles, and pinned proof evidence for the claimed charter method.
# This is not an exhaustive gap census. Omitted invariants are not cleared by this audit.
# Do not copy status totals or promote invariant_status.tsv / special_method_coverage.tsv rows.
# claim_source names sibling indexes and row selectors; evidence/owner paths are repo-relative.
# A #function suffix identifies an existing entrypoint, not a new test.
# Next owners are existing modules, not people. cu/ mounts in v16_cu; stateful/ mounts in
# v16_program_stateful_fuzz; kani/ mounts in v16-kani. No runtime/proof results were produced.
# Close an index gap by linking existing evidence first; if no qualifying owner exists,
# leave the method gap explicit and schedule a generic test under the recommended module.
